title: From averaged slice identities to the pointwise slice identity for a.e. t, with a null set independent of the test form
statement:
Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open. Let RT = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U of dimension n+1 (IMRep U (n+1)), RB = (M', θ', ξ') an integer multiplicity triple in U of dimension n (IMRep U n), (R_s)_{s∈ℝ} a family of integer multiplicity triples in U of dimension n (Rs : ℝ → IMRep U n), and f : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel measurable. For an integer multiplicity triple R = (N, φ, ζ) write τ(R)(ω) := ∫_N φ⟨ω, ζ⟩ dHⁿ (R.action ω), and put γ_{a,b}(s) := min{1, max{0, (b − s)/(b − a)}}. Assume:
(i) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), the function s ↦ τ(R_s)(ω) is locally integrable on ℝ;
(ii) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) and all real a < b,
  ∫_a^b τ(R_s)(ω) ds = (b − a)·( ∫_M θ·γ_{a,b}(f)·⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{n+1} − ∫_{M'} θ'·γ_{a,b}(f)·⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dHⁿ ).
Then for L¹-almost every t ∈ ℝ, simultaneously for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U),
  τ(R_t)(ω) = ∫_{M∩{f<t}} θ⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{n+1} − ∫_{M'∩{f<t}} θ'⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dHⁿ.
(Hⁿ = μHE[n], d = exteriorDerivative, ⟨α, ζ⟩ = ζ(α).)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (RT : IMRep U (n + 1)) (RB : IMRep U n) (Rs : ℝ → IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → Measurable f → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, LocallyIntegrable (fun s => (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n))) → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn U n) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∫ s in a..b, (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = (b - a) * ((∫ x in RT.carrier, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n])) → ∀ᵐ t, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, (Rs t).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]
